# 雷霆打擊附魔

[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/discord/1327308441324097681?label=discord&color=blue&logo=discord)](https://discord.gg/5UdcDa5xNC)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/thunder-strike-enchantment?label=modrinth&logo=modrinth)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/thunder-strike-enchantment)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/lullaby6/data-packs)](https://github.com/lullaby6/data-packs/blob/main/LICENSE)

## 📖 說明

全新的戰鎚附魔，共有三個等級，每次發動蓄力攻擊命中時皆會召喚閃電！

此附魔可透過附魔台、戰利品寶箱或與村民交易取得。

## ⌨️ 指令

給予：

```mcfunction
/loot give @s loot thunder_strike_enchantment:<level>
```

附魔：

```mcfunction
/enchant @s thunder_strike_enchantment:thunder_strike <level>
```
